eventDetail.scope: NPSIF 2026 will be an international forum on technological innovation in new power systems and new energy industries. It will focus on topics such as new power system planning, data-driven dispatch and control, smart microgrids, intelligent power and energy systems, digital grid technologies, intelligent sensors, energy blockchain, source-grid-load-storage interaction, virtual power plants, new energy storage, smart metering, and power communication. The conference will also cover flexible grid interconnection, stability optimization, demand response, vehicle-grid interaction, electric-carbon monitoring, communication security, and carbon-electricity applications. Through interdisciplinary exchange, NPSIF 2026 aims to promote the low-carbon, digital, and intelligent transformation of modern power systems.
